findings.description: The async OR overload checks for `retry_all` instead of `retry_any`, converting a left-hand conjunction into a disjunction.
findings.rationale: For async predicates A=False, B=True, and C=False, composing `retry_all(A, B) | retry_any(C)` reaches this branch and produces `retry_any(A, B, C)`. The result is True instead of False, so an operation is retried even though the configured retry condition rejects it.
